title: Entitlement
description: Upstream authorization record from which leases are issued. Source of truth: DSL Best Practices Chapter 11.02 (Entitlement Object).

app.description: Product or application identifier. NOTE (delta D2): spec uses 'app'; group to confirm whether to standardize on 'appId'.

isvId.description: Independent software vendor identifier. NOTE (delta D3, spec-gap): adopted from the reference implementation for multi-vendor isolation; optional pending spec adoption.

allowedModalities.description: License modalities that may be granted from this entitlement.

dimensions.description: Maximum grantable dimensions and limits. Dimension names are vendor-defined (examples: CHANNELS, FPS).

defaultPolicy.description: Baseline vendor-defined policy attached to the entitlement.

quota.description: Limits on simultaneous or aggregate grants. NOTE (delta D6): spec uses nested quota.maxActiveLeases; implementation uses flat maxLeases/activeLeases.

scope.description: Optional project, environment, or operational scope restrictions.

validUntil.description: End of entitlement validity, if bounded.
